basis: Demo 25's README, calibrated on the Demo 23 work-laptop timing: roughly 10-30 s per k point at 32 states with full per-k envelopes. Disk dominates - Demo 23 wrote 18 MB per case with envelopes at k=0 only. The real number is measured by the 27A pilot, and Demo 25 will recommend a smaller matrix-element grid if 301 points would exceed its 12 h / 60 GB budgets. Matrix elements vary slowly with k while energies set the resonance positions, so a coarser M(k) grid interpolated onto the fine energy grid loses very little.
